prompt: Extract a b0 volume from the diffusion series of sub-CON05 (ses-preop, ds001226, OpenNeuro) and produce a binary brain mask on the diffusion grid.
focal_basis: max(1.5 x worst held-out focal miss, 5.0 cm3 floor), both measured as the largest component surviving a max(1.5 mm, one voxel) shave, as the scorer measures a submission; shave 2.5 mm here, worst held-out miss 7.59 cm3
focal_bg_basis: max(1.5 x worst legitimate non-panel inclusion, 10 cm3 backstop). Measured on every non-panel mask available: well-chosen invocations (HD-BET and SynthStrip at defaults, BET -R, BET default on paediatric) admit 0.00-3.87 cm3, while BET at its defaults on motion-corrupted T1w admits 16.67-113.27 cm3. The cap sits in the empty band between them. It is deliberately looser than the core cap: lost brain is unrecoverable, whereas retained skull is visible and downstream-recoverable, so the gate catches only gross inclusion and bg_fp_frac_of_ref (weight 0.20) prices the gradient. Evidence is thin -- 16 legitimate masks from three tasks, none over-inclusive for 3T, stroke or diffusion.
